facts.value: Gain the practical skills you need for a career in economics and economics related fields with UL’s highly ranked one-year, full-time Master of Science (MSc) in Economics and Policy Analysis.
This programme features a strong focus on policy aspects of economics in areas such as macroeconomics, health economics, industrial development, education and labour.
ranked in the top 50 Masters in Western Europe by EdUniversal Best Masters
has an extremely strong employment record, with past graduates working across the private and public sector.

It is the only Master's course in economics in Ireland that offers the potential for students to gain a double degree and enhance their international exposure and career opportunities through our partnership with HEC Liège (the Business School of the University of Liège).
Gain applied economic skills such as data analysis, econometrics and policy analysis.
Develop a broader understanding of contemporary economic theories.
Explore some of the key challenges facing the global economy.
